required_facts.claim: You can usually tell when a website was created by AI.
required_facts.source_evidence: You can usually tell when a website was created by AI.

required_facts.claim: It often happens with “one-shot designs”: you ask a coding assistant to create a website, open the result, and immediately see that it is AI-generated.
required_facts.source_evidence: It often happens with “one-shot designs”: you ask a coding assistant to create a website, open the result, and immediately see that it is AI-generated.

required_facts.claim: A lot of the time, that is completely fine.
required_facts.source_evidence: A lot of the time, that is completely fine.

required_facts.claim: For a simple website, one-shot is more than enough, and it’s way better than what I could ever design myself.
required_facts.source_evidence: For a simple website, one-shot is more than enough, and it’s way better than what I could ever design myself.

required_facts.claim: But I don’t want my websites to look too generic.
required_facts.source_evidence: But I don’t want my websites to look too generic.

required_facts.claim: There are thousands of web pages now that all look the same.
required_facts.source_evidence: There are thousands of web pages now that all look the same.

required_facts.claim: In writing, we have markers like “delve” or excessive bold formatting that give away AI-generated text.
required_facts.source_evidence: In writing, we have markers like “delve” or excessive bold formatting that give away AI-generated text.

required_facts.claim: In design, there are similar elements you notice immediately.
required_facts.source_evidence: In design, there are similar elements you notice immediately.

required_facts.claim: They tend to grow overly complex, with elements not always where I’d expect them.
required_facts.source_evidence: They tend to grow overly complex, with elements not always where I’d expect them.

required_facts.claim: Each new page brings elements that don’t match the rest.
required_facts.source_evidence: Each new page brings elements that don’t match the rest.
